cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(MemoriaPsfDecoder C)
include(TestBigEndian)
test_big_endian(IS_BIG_ENDIAN)
add_executable(Memoria.PsfDecoder decoder.c src/bios.c src/iop.c src/ioptimer.c src/psx.c src/r3000.c src/spu.c src/spucore.c src/vfs.c)
target_include_directories(Memoria.PsfDecoder PRIVATE include)
target_compile_definitions(Memoria.PsfDecoder PRIVATE EMU_COMPILE HAVE_STDINT_H)
if(IS_BIG_ENDIAN)
  target_compile_definitions(Memoria.PsfDecoder PRIVATE EMU_BIG_ENDIAN)
else()
  target_compile_definitions(Memoria.PsfDecoder PRIVATE EMU_LITTLE_ENDIAN)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_definitions(Memoria.PsfDecoder PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
  set_property(TARGET Memoria.PsfDecoder PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
else()
  target_link_libraries(Memoria.PsfDecoder PRIVATE m)
endif()
install(TARGETS Memoria.PsfDecoder RUNTIME DESTINATION .)
